title: Legal Manager ( Real Estate ) 8-10 years
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – LEGAL MANAGER ( REAL ESTATE)

**Industry:** Real Estate / Property Development  
**Department:** Legal  
**Designation:** Legal Manager

**Experience:** 08-10 years  
**Salary Range:** ₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month  
**Location:** Chennai

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Legal Manager to handle legal documentation, property registration, land-related legal matters, and statutory approvals for our real estate projects. The candidate should have strong knowledge of property laws, excellent drafting skills, and the ability to maintain a good professional rapport with government officials and registration authorities.

Key Responsibilities1. Legal Document Drafting

* Draft, review, and finalize sale agreements, construction agreements, allocation agreements, joint venture agreements, and other property-related legal documents.
* Prepare and review sale deeds, power of attorney documents, affidavits, undertakings, and related legal paperwork.
* Verify land documents, title deeds, encumbrance certificates, parent documents, patta, chitta, and other relevant property records.
* Ensure the accuracy and legal compliance of all documents before execution and registration.
* Maintain physical and digital copies of legal documents with proper project-wise filing.

2. Property Registration Process

* Coordinate and manage the registration of sale deeds, construction agreements, and other property-related documents.
* Liaise with Sub-Registrar Offices (SROs), registration departments, and other relevant authorities.
* Verify document requirements, stamp duty, registration fees, and applicable statutory procedures.
* Coordinate with customers, legal consultants, advocates, and internal departments to complete registrations on time.
* Track registration status and ensure registered documents are collected and filed properly.

3. Government Liaison and Approvals

* Maintain a strong and professional working relationship with government officials, registration authorities, revenue department officials, and other relevant departments.
* Coordinate for property records, land-related documentation, statutory approvals, and required certificates.
* Follow up on pending applications and resolve documentation-related issues through lawful procedures.
* Stay updated on changes in property laws, registration rules, government procedures, and applicable regulations.

4. Real Estate Project Legal Support

* Handle legal documentation for apartment, villa, residential layout, and land development projects.
* Support land acquisition, joint venture arrangements, landowner agreements, and property due diligence.
* Coordinate for APF processing, project documentation, and other applicable legal formalities.
* Respond to customer legal queries and support the sales and CRM teams with property-related documentation.
* Identify legal risks and escalate title disputes, encumbrances, and other significant issues to management.

5. Team Coordination and Reporting

* Coordinate with Sales, CRM, Accounts, Purchase, and Project teams for legal requirements.
* Maintain a project-wise tracker for agreements, registrations, approvals, and pending legal matters.
* Monitor document preparation and registration timelines.
* Provide regular updates to management regarding registration progress, pending approvals, and legal risks.
* Supervise legal executives or documentation staff, where applicable.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Law (LL.B.) is preferred.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in real estate legal documentation and property registration.
* Strong knowledge of property laws and registration procedures in Tamil Nadu.
* Hands-on experience in drafting and reviewing property-related legal documents.
* Proven experience coordinating with Sub-Registrar Offices and government departments.
* Good communication, negotiation, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, document management, and legal record maintenance.

Key Skills

* Legal drafting and document verification
* Property registration and statutory compliance
* Government liaison and professional relationship management
* Land documentation and title verification
* Real estate legal due diligence
* Follow-up and issue resolution
* Team management and reporting
* Attention to detail and time management

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of legal document drafting and review.
* Percentage of property registrations completed within the planned timeline.
* Accuracy and completeness of legal documentation.
* Timely follow-up on approvals and pending registrations.
* Reduction in documentation errors and registration delays.
* Effective resolution of customer and internal legal queries.
* Proper maintenance of project-wise legal records.
* Compliance with applicable laws and registration procedures.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
